search_window.basis: Start is the completed_at of the immediately preceding, directly retrieved watch-ledger heartbeat. Targeted searches used up to seven-day discovery recency for late-indexed reports but only distinct new, verified qualifying disruptions within the bounded interval were eligible.

coverage_notes: Supplementary four-class recall watch only; primary nationwide Food Line production collection remains authoritative.

All 12 bounded fast web searches returned without an error. No newly verifiable U.S. sole/full-service grocery loss, weather-related emergency distribution cancellation, abrupt food-bank/pantry loss, or official current SNAP/WIC benefit interruption was found in the prior-hour interval. Search non-detection is not proof of national absence.

Excluded October 2026 Aurora, NC new grocery-market opening; January 2026 Ovid, NY anniversary stories about a January 2025 fire; earlier disaster response/recovery pages; October 2025 SNAP funding/shutdown notices; generic food assistance calendars and resource guides.

The previously recorded Provo, Utah Community Action Services and Food Bank closure candidate from the 2026-10-31 06:47 PT watch is a prior finding; no new confirmed development warranted a second finding.

A generic third-party EBT status dashboard reporting no broad national outage at 05:07 PT was not used to infer official nationwide SNAP/WIC availability. Preannounced November 2026 SNAP retailer/rule changes were not treated as new interruptions.
